title: Delayed Count of Equal Elements
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n and an integer k, for each index i, count the number of indices j where i + k < j <= n - 1 and nums[j] equals nums[i].
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n and an integer k, for each index i, count the number of indices j where i + k < j <= n - 1 and nums[j] equals nums[i]. Return an array ans where ans[i] represents this count for each i.
constraints: nums has up to 100,000 integers and k is nonnegative.
For every i, count equal values at indices j satisfying j>i+k.
Return one count for every input index.
reference_solution:
def delayed_equal_counts(nums,k):
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter();answer=[0]*len(nums)
    for i in range(len(nums)-k-2,-1,-1):
        counts[nums[i+k+1]]+=1
        answer[i]=counts[nums[i]]
    return answer
